summary: FD_TC_078_No Travel Origin, Safety (arrival delay code 41, aircraft defects), APPR, Basic Aeroplan
title: No Travel Origin, Safety (arrival delay code 41, aircraft defects), APPR, Basic Aeroplan
description:
A single-leg flight is delayed more than 3 hours by arrival delay code 41. During the pre-departure check at YUL, the crew found a hydraulic leak on the aircraft operating AC 470, and it had to be repaired before the flight could leave (Safety). The customer chose not to travel and stayed at the origin. Checks that DDS classes code 41 as Safety and returns NE-14 (no cash compensation, expenses plus full refund entitlement), and that the linked Aeroplan Basic profile (tier A) is shown but doesn't change the outcome.

Prerequisites:
PNR TC066: one adult passenger, �mile Gagnon. One AC domestic leg: AC 470, YUL?YYZ, May 31, 2026. Scheduled 10:00 ? 12:00. Actual departure 14:15 (255 min late). Actual arrival 16:20 (260 min late). Status: DELAYED (operated). Cancellation code: NONE. First arrival delay code 41 (TD). First departure delay code 41 (TD). No other delay codes on the MSL. Defect found on the operating aircraft at YUL, not upline. Passenger not boarded, coupon not flown. Customer stayed at YUL. No Travel status: Origin. No rebooking accepted. Aeroplan: linked, tier code A (Aeroplan Basic). No expense receipts. Fallback: FALSE. Regime: APPR. More than 72 hours have passed. Filed within 366 days.
